subject: Intro request: budget approver & procurement steps for Cobalt Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@cobaltsys.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro request: budget approver & procurement steps for Cobalt Systems

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap:
- Your team runs a mixed workload (batch embedding + interactive chat assistants) on-prem today and is evaluating a hybrid inferencing model.
- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms 95th latency for chat, predictable monthly spend, and audit-ready logs for clinical PII.
- Key internal stakeholders you mentioned: ML Eng (you), Platform Ops, Security, and Procurement/Finance for budget signoff.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Intro to the person who signs off on spend (budget owner / finance approver) so we can map budget cycle and procurement constraints.
2) Short tech check with your security lead to validate SSO/KMS and SOC2 evidence.
3) Draft a mutual action plan (1 pager) and a procurement checklist for your process.

Could you please introduce me to the budget approver and to the procurement contact (Tom?) and security lead (Lina?) on a single thread? If helpful, I attached a brief procurement-outline you can share internally.

We can also provide a high-level pricing band now for planning, and then firm numbers in the proposal once we confirm expected throughput and retention.

Availability: I can meet with your team Wed/Thu 10–12 PT or next Monday afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: procurement-outline.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]
From: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@cobaltsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro request: budget approver & procurement steps for Cobalt Systems

Jordan —

Appreciate the summary and the outline. I’m looping in two folks to connect the right players:
- Tom Alvarez (Procurement) — tom.alvarez@cobaltsys.com
- Lina Gomez (Head of Security) — lina.gomez@cobaltsys.com

Tom/Lina: Jordan and his team from Redwood ran a demo for us yesterday focused on hybrid inference and cost controls. We’d like a short call to understand contract cadence and security evidence.

A couple of asks from our side to prepare:
- Ballpark pricing range for the hosted vs. dedicated options (monthly committed spend ranges).
- Confirmation on SSO integrations (SAML) and KMS/HSM support for key material.
- Do you have a current SOC2 Type II report and a short data retention/segregation summary?

Procurement timeline: we’re targeting a decision by end of December but need to route an MSA through legal + procurement in November.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, ML Engineering
Cobalt Systems
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@cobaltsys.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cobaltsys.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: budget approver & procurement steps for Cobalt Systems

Thanks Priya — and hi Tom / Lina, great to e-meet. I’ve added Laura (Sales Lead) and Evelyn (Solutions Engineering) who will help with procurement and security artifacts.

Quick answers up front:
- Pricing (very high level): hosted API ranges typically fall between $8k–$25k/mo depending on token volume; dedicated pools start at ~$65k/mo for small reserved clusters (net of committed T&Cs). We’ll produce a modeled estimate once you share expected tokens/month and concurrent session profile.
- SSO / KMS: Redwood supports SAML SSO and integrates with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and customer HSM via KMIP). We can detail the exact HSM modes in the security call.
- SOC2 & retention: attaching a short security summary and a redwood security matrix; we will provide SOC2 Type II and data processing addendum (DPA) via secure link to your legal team.

Next proposed step: 30–45 minute triage call (Jordan + Evelyn + Priya + Lina + Tom) to validate evidence and map procurement steps. Proposed times: Thu 11/5 9:30–10:15 PT or Thu 11/5 11:00–11:45 PT. Please confirm which works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-mapping.xlsx (mutual action plan template), redwood-security-summary.pdf (security highlights).

Thanks — happy to tighten pricing if you share a short usage sketch.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-security-summary.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

Subject: Re: Intro request: budget approver & procurement steps for Cobalt Systems

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the details. Thu 11/5 11:00–11:45 PT works for procurement + security. Please include a DocuSign-ready MSA template and the SOC2 download link in the calendar invite so legal can prelim review.

Procurement heads-up: we will need:
- SOC2 Type II (latest) and vendor risk questionnaire answered in full.
- Example invoice/ordering terms and who to bill (we use Net 60 by default).
- Confirmation of termination clauses and SLA credits for latency SLO misses.

Tom Alvarez
Senior Procurement Manager | Cobalt Systems
